### What does this PR do?

This PR adds native Megatron-Core `HybridModel` MTP support for NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and Nemotron 3.5 Super VL. Lightning has SFT and GRPO examples; Super VL has image/text SFT through its multimodal wrapper. GPU validation of Super VL is pending.

- Uses Megatron-Core's native HybridModel MTP target/loss path instead of verl's legacy GPT MTP patches.
- Preserves response-aware MTP loss masking and supplies packed-sequence metadata required to reset Mamba state across samples.
- Retains current-`main` context-parallel layouts, padding buckets, FP8 padding, and legacy GPT shifted-label behavior.
- Rejects undersized packed labels instead of silently fabricating targets, while trimming ordinary dense right padding.
- Cleans up HybridProvider-only MTP overrides when MTP is disabled.
- Adds Nemotron 3.5 Lightning SFT and replaces the older Super example with Nemotron 3.5 Super VL image/text SFT.
- Recognizes the nested HybridModel decoder and `llm_config` MTP fields in Super VL; preserves its shared MTP block across two prediction depths.
- Packs variable-resolution RADIO image inputs with image sizes and frame counts, supports mixed text/image batches, and rejects unsupported video/audio and CP>1 configurations.
- Adds a Nemotron 3.5 Lightning GRPO launcher whose validated defaults enable R3 router replay and one-token MTP speculation.
- Fails fast when R3 uses an unsupported vLLM version: vLLM >= 0.22 for R3 alone and >= 0.26 for R3 combined with MTP speculation.
- Adds a reproducible NGC-based container recipe installed from the repository's canonical `uv.lock`.

The GRPO defaults reproduce the drift-reduction settings used in validation: raw log probabilities, fixed seeds, temperature 1, CP=1, FP32 routers, disabled prefix caching/dynamic batching/batch balancing, and disabled router/permutation fusion.

This does not duplicate another contribution: earlier [Lightning/HybridModel searches](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+%22HybridModel%22+MTP) returned only this PR; the [Super VL search](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+%22Nemotron%22+%22Super%22+%22VL%22+in%3Atitle%2Cbody) found no overlapping open PR before this update.

### Immutable references

- Current upstream `main` merge parent: `f2923cbf154731918b1e36db8c567433f349fede`
- H100-validated v0.7 implementation: `dc3421cf63fbfbf7aecb191bbca1e0fb0707e90d`
- v0.7 follow-up carrying the undersized-label guard: `7f3c945815b759b004cb6a9e1e92f35de31f8b9f`
- Nemotron 3.5 Lightning checkpoint: `d468880b6ad3c6e0d21377ce7242adaea4cc884d`
- Nemotron 3.5 Super VL checkpoint: `1f8953f7f0935358e3605150d22bc15df062061c`
- Super VL Bridge source: `e97a67acbf1b7a8ae0a0e0f26c60fa9548e19bfe`
- Super VL paired Core source: `89b28875a8d786ab41333bc60e7e8022e83e8f65`
- GSM8K: `740312add88f781978c0658806c59bc2815b9866`
- DAPO-Math-17k: `65877096c24ffa7abc4e4fa5edb95cf3413a5674`
- AIME-2024: `aa49075e24ad594b79fdf0bdcefa735c2181be67`

The current upstream lock uses vLLM v0.29.0 (`98dff2a81d747d1dba01a47f939f48c3526d4206`), Megatron Bridge v0.6.2 (`c0e164ed2aedac4ad1c877780e2564a19d5d54ec`), and Megatron Core v0.19.2 (`4b4acac9a1d28ea6829c8d4f566d75698a21249d`). The earlier H100 runs used vLLM v0.27.1 (`6e448d0ea9bf3d88d898b65449ca6dc2aec170ac`), Megatron Bridge r0.6.0 (`c93251151adeeadbae3ff2a2bf5ee7a1c34cff01`), and Megatron Core 0.19.0 (`cd4afffa648426a959dc7cb1e24b5ce7d0c3ff54`).

```bash
UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/verl-uv-cache uv run --no-sync pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider \
  tests/models/test_mcore_native_hybrid_mtp_on_cpu.py \
  tests/utils/test_megatron_bshd_preprocess.py \
  tests/workers/rollout/rollout_vllm/test_vllm_router_replay_version_guard_on_cpu.py \
  tests/utils/dataset/test_nemotron_omni_sft_dataset_on_cpu.py \
  tests/utils/test_tokenizer_normalize_on_cpu.py
# 82 passed, 1 skipped

PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/verl-pycache uv run --no-sync pre-commit run --files \
  $(git diff --name-only upstream/main...HEAD)
# All hooks passed for the 12 files changed in the Super VL update; previous branch files passed before the update

UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/verl-uv-cache uv lock --check
# Resolved 364 packages successfully

docker buildx build --check -f docker/Dockerfile.nemotron_3_5_lightning .
# Completed with no warnings

git diff upstream/main --check
# Exit 0
```

The Super VL launcher passed `bash -n`, one-process `torchrun` Hydra `--cfg job` composition, and a negative CP=2 check. Both Lightning launchers passed config composition in the preceding update; their R3 checks reject CP != 1, temperature != 1, and more than one speculative token. A real Super VL processor/dataset smoke test passed on Transformers 5.12.1 and an isolated 5.20.1 environment without model weights: mixed text/image samples, multiple image turns and resolutions, 4 images producing 4,352 RADIO patches and 1,088 image placeholder tokens, all excluded from the language loss. Historical Nemotron 3 Super validation completed one full SFT optimizer step on 32 H100 GPUs. Main loss was `0.6796031`, MTP losses were `0.7411741` and `0.8213301`, and gradient norm was `7.232836`. This is not Super VL validation.

The following Lightning runs exercised the corresponding implementation on the v0.7 backport using 2 hosts x 8 H100 80 GB GPUs. Each stopped at its configured external wall-time rather than from a fatal training failure:

| Run | Duration / progress | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Full SFT](https://wandb.ai/nvidia-nemo-framework/verl-nemotron-3-5-lightning-validation/runs/pr2-v070-sft-2h-15979643?nw=nwuserppetrakian) | 2 hours / 2,116 optimizer steps | Finite main and MTP losses throughout |
| [Full GRPO, R3 + MTP](https://wandb.ai/nvidia-nemo-framework/verl-nemotron-3-5-lightning-validation/runs/pr2-v070-grpo-mtp-r3-4h-15991749?nw=nwuserppetrakian) | 4 hours / 261 steps | Final rollout/actor mean probability difference `0.003526`; Pearson `0.99957` |
| [LoRA SFT](https://wandb.ai/nvidia-nemo-framework/verl-nemotron-3-5-lightning-validation/runs/pr2-v070-sft-lora-2h-16075152?nw=nwuserppetrakian) | 2 hours / 2,199 steps | Finite training; adapter checkpoints through step 2,000 |
| [LoRA GRPO, R3](https://wandb.ai/nvidia-nemo-framework/verl-nemotron-3-5-lightning-validation/runs/pr2-v070-grpo-lora-r3-2h-16109017?nw=nwuserppetrakian) | 2 hours / 235 steps | Final mean probability difference `0.00324`; Pearson `0.99962`; KL `0.000356`; checkpoint through step 200 |

The GRPO measurements show small, nonzero vLLM/Megatron probability differences with very high correlation; they do not claim bitwise-identical log probabilities. The LoRA runs validate the shared downstream path but LoRA launchers/checkpoint changes are scoped to the separate v0.7 backport, not this PR.

The earlier Lightning GPU runs validated checkpoint loading, native MTP training, R3 route replay, one-token MTP rollout, BF16 actor-to-rollout synchronization, finite repeated updates, and the tested checkpoint paths. Convergence, checkpoint restore, quantized synchronization, alternate topologies, Super VL GPU training, and this exact merged-main head on GPUs remain unvalidated.

### API and Usage Example

Build the Lightning image from a clean checkout of the exact PR head:

```bash
docker build --build-arg VERL_COMMIT="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" \
  -f docker/Dockerfile.nemotron_3_5_lightning \
  -t verl-nemotron-3-5-lightning .
```

Download the exact model and GRPO dataset snapshots:

```bash
hf download nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16 \
  --revision d468880b6ad3c6e0d21377ce7242adaea4cc884d \
  --local-dir "$HOME/models/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16"
hf download BytedTsinghua-SIA/DAPO-Math-17k data/dapo-math-17k.parquet \
  --repo-type dataset --revision 65877096c24ffa7abc4e4fa5edb95cf3413a5674 \
  --local-dir "$HOME/verl/data/DAPO-Math-17k"
hf download BytedTsinghua-SIA/AIME-2024 data/aime-2024.parquet \
  --repo-type dataset --revision aa49075e24ad594b79fdf0bdcefa735c2181be67 \
  --local-dir "$HOME/verl/data/AIME-2024"
```

Current `main` does not expose a Hub revision through `HFModelConfig`; set `MODEL_PATH` to the local snapshot above for exact reproduction.

Prepare message-formatted GSM8K for SFT:

```bash
python examples/data_preprocess/gsm8k_multiturn_sft.py \
  --revision 740312add88f781978c0658806c59bc2815b9866 \
  --local_save_dir "$HOME/data/gsm8k_sft"
```

Run Lightning SFT once per host with the same rendezvous address and a distinct node rank:

```bash
MODEL_PATH="$HOME/models/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16" \
DATASET_DIR="$HOME/data/gsm8k_sft" CHECKPOINT_DIR=/shared/output/sft \
NNODES=2 NGPUS_PER_NODE=8 NODE_RANK=0 \
MASTER_ADDR=node-0.example.internal MASTER_PORT=29500 \
bash examples/sft/gsm8k/run_nemotron_3_5_lightning_megatron.sh
```

Use `NODE_RANK=1` on the second host. For GRPO, form a 2-host Ray cluster and run once on its head:

```bash
MODEL_PATH="$HOME/models/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16" \
DATA_DIR="$HOME/verl" CHECKPOINT_DIR=/shared/output/grpo \
NNODES=2 NGPUS_PER_NODE=8 ROUTER_REPLAY_MODE=R3 MTP_ROLLOUT_SPEC=1 \
bash examples/grpo_trainer/run_nemotron_3_5_lightning_30b_a3b_megatron.sh
```

Use identical image, model, data, and output paths on both hosts. Inject credentials such as `WANDB_API_KEY` only at runtime.

Super VL image/text SFT uses `examples/sft/vlm/run_nemotron_3_5_super_vl_megatron.sh` with the pinned Bridge/Core source pair and Transformers 5.20.1. Follow the setup and checkpoint download commands in [the MTP guide](https://github.com/Phlip79/verl/blob/7f76b9062f1e84cb5e3219a8b8a6a7a51dc4c4b4/docs/advance/mtp.md#7-nemotron-35-super-vl-sft), prepare `examples/data_preprocess/pokemon.py`, and launch once per host. Defaults are 4×8 GPUs, TP2/PP1/EP16/CP1, frozen vision encoder, trainable projector/decoder, and two shared MTP prediction depths. Video/audio, Super VL GRPO/R3/speculative rollout, quantization, and restore are outside the verified scope.

### Design & Code Changes

- Native HybridModels receive unshifted `input_ids` targets and an unshifted response-aware MTP loss mask; legacy GPT models retain their shifted labels/masks.
- `PackedSeqParams.total_tokens` is supplied only for Hybrid/Mamba models so current-main behavior remains unchanged for other models.
- Provider-specific repeated-layer overrides are applied only after identifying a HybridProvider.
- R3 + MTP version validation examines vLLM's effective normalized speculative configuration, including `engine_kwargs` overrides.
- The image starts from `nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.06-py3` and installs the repository's frozen Megatron + vLLM extras into an isolated project venv; the exact locked stack should receive a fresh GPU smoke/soak before this PR leaves draft.

AI assistance was used to investigate, implement, test, review, and prepare this PR. The human submitter should review and understand every changed line before sharing or merging.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Search for overlapping open PRs; the queries returned only this PR.
- [x] Merge current upstream `main` and resolve conflicts.
- [x] Preserve current-main CP/padding behavior and add focused regression coverage.
- [x] Run pre-commit across every file changed relative to upstream `main`.
- [x] Record immutable source, dependency, model, and dataset revisions.
- [x] Document downstream H100 validation and its limits.
- [ ] Run a GPU smoke test on the final merged-main head.

- Native HybridModels receive unshifted `input_ids` targets and an unshifted response-aware MTP loss mask; legacy GPT models retain their shifted labels/masks.

- Provider-specific repeated-layer overrides are applied only after identifying a HybridProvider.
- R3 + MTP version validation examines vLLM's effective normalized speculative configuration, including `engine_kwargs` overrides.
- The image starts from `nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.06-py3` and installs the repository's frozen Megatron + vLLM extras into an isolated project venv; the exact locked stack should receive a fresh GPU smoke/soak before this PR leaves draft.

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# SFT | NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B | Megatron | NVIDIA H100
+#
+# This launcher keeps Lightning's native MTP block. Its topology and core
+# hyperparameters are adapted from NVIDIA's verified 4K full-SFT recipe:
+# 2 nodes x 8 H100, TP=2, EP=8, MBS=1.
+# Run it on every node with the same MASTER_ADDR/MASTER_PORT and a distinct
+# NODE_RANK, for example:
+#   MASTER_ADDR=<node-0-hostname> NODE_RANK=0 \
+#     bash examples/sft/gsm8k/run_nemotron_3_5_lightning_megatron.sh
+#
+# Current upstream uv.lock dependency set:
+#   Megatron-Bridge 0.6.2
+#   Megatron-Core 0.19.2
+#   Transformers 5.12.1
+#   vLLM 0.29.0
+#
+# Use the Bridge 0.6.2 / MCore 0.19.2 pair pinned by uv.lock. The public
+# Lightning checkpoint revision used for hardware validation is:
+#   d468880b6ad3c6e0d21377ce7242adaea4cc884d
+
+set -xeuo pipefail
+
+# ============================================================
+# Distributed: 2 nodes x 8 GPUs
+# ============================================================
+NGPUS_PER_NODE=${NGPUS_PER_NODE:-${NUM_GPUS:-8}}
+NNODES=${NNODES:-2}
+NODE_RANK=${NODE_RANK:-0}
+MASTER_ADDR=${MASTER_ADDR:-localhost}
+MASTER_PORT=${MASTER_PORT:-29500}
+PYTHON_BIN=${PYTHON_BIN:-python3}
+
+# ============================================================
+# Data and model

+# Prepare the message-formatted SFT dataset with:
+#   python examples/data_preprocess/gsm8k_multiturn_sft.py \
+#     --revision 740312add88f781978c0658806c59bc2815b9866 \
+#     --local_save_dir "$HOME/data/gsm8k_sft"
+DATASET_DIR=${DATASET_DIR:-${HOME}/data/gsm8k_sft}
+TRAIN_FILES=${TRAIN_FILES:-${DATASET_DIR}/train.parquet}
+VAL_FILES=${VAL_FILES:-${DATASET_DIR}/test.parquet}
+

+#   hf download nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16 \
+#     --revision d468880b6ad3c6e0d21377ce7242adaea4cc884d \
+#     --local-dir "$HOME/models/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16"
